anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all intervals (1, 5, and 15 minutes), indicating potential overutilization or a bottleneck.
AI system has not generated any learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, indicating a potential issue with AI functionality or configuration.
Trading metrics show no active trades or profit/loss, which might suggest an issue with trading activity or strategy execution.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU usage by analyzing running processes and workloads to identify and alleviate bottlenecks.
Review and potentially reconfigure AI systems to ensure they are actively learning and generating trading opportunities.
Evaluate and possibly adjust trading strategies to ensure they are executing as expected and contributing to trading activity.

recommendations.action: Conduct a thorough investigation of CPU-intensive processes and optimize or redistribute workloads to prevent system degradation.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, affecting trading operations and user experience.

recommendations.action: Assess AI system configuration and logs to identify reasons for inactivity and rectify any issues preventing learning and opportunity generation.
recommendations.rationale: AI inactivity can result in missed trading opportunities and reduced platform effectiveness.

recommendations.action: Review and test active trading strategies to ensure they are functioning correctly and making trades as intended.
recommendations.rationale: Inactive trading strategies can lead to missed profit opportunities and affect overall platform performance.
